map.为何对长度敏感？: Why is it sensitive to length?
map.悬臂端挠度正比 L⁴，长度翻倍挠度约 16 倍。: Cantilever tip deflection scales with L⁴, so doubling the length multiplies deflection by about 16.
map.与简支梁比？: Compared with a simply supported beam?
map.同跨同载下悬臂端挠度明显大于简支跨中。: Under the same span and load, cantilever tip deflection is markedly larger than mid-span deflection of a simply supported beam.
